description: This file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the Aws\EndpointDiscovery namespace. It provides various static methods to generate configuration providers for AWS endpoint discovery, including environment-based, fallbacks, ini file parsing, and composing multiple providers. It also includes constants for default settings and helper methods for unwrapping configurations.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods to create configuration providers for AWS endpoint discovery, including environment-variable-based, ini-file-based, fallback logic, and provider composition.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that reads endpoint discovery enabled status from environment variables.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Creates a fallback configuration based on API operation needs or defaults.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider based on a specified or default ini configuration file.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps a configuration object or promise into a ConfigurationInterface instance.
